claims.text: A processor-implemented method for classifying digital records using a trained feature model.
The method of claim 1, wherein the trained feature model includes a neural network.
The method of claim 2, wherein the neural network generates a normalized feature vector.
A data processing system comprising a memory and a processor configured to retrieve indexed documents.
The system of claim 1, wherein the processor ranks the indexed documents according to semantic similarity.
The system of claim 1, wherein the memory stores vector representations of the indexed documents.
A computer-readable medium storing instructions for detecting an anomaly in sensor data.
The computer-readable medium of claim 1, wherein the instructions calculate a temporal feature.
The computer-readable medium of claim 1, wherein the instructions calculate a frequency-domain feature.
The computer-readable medium of claims 2 and 3, wherein the anomaly is detected from both features.
A wireless communication apparatus comprising a transmitter configured to send a radio signal.
The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the transmitter applies adaptive modulation.
The apparatus of claim 2, wherein a modulation order is selected using channel quality.
A method for establishing a secure communication session between a first device and a second device.
The method of claim 1, wherein the first device transmits an authentication token.
The method of claim 2, wherein the authentication token is cryptographically signed.
A receiver configured to decode a radio transmission using an error-correcting code.
An antenna assembly configured to receive the radio transmission.
The receiver of claim 1 coupled to the antenna assembly of claim 2.
The receiver of claim 3, wherein decoding uses an iterative parity check.
A medical monitoring device comprising an optical sensor configured to measure a physiological signal.
The medical monitoring device of claim 1, wherein the optical sensor measures blood oxygen saturation.
The medical monitoring device of claim 2, further comprising a display for presenting the saturation.
A pharmaceutical composition comprising an active compound and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.
The composition of claim 1, wherein the active compound is present within a specified concentration range.
The composition of claim 2, wherein the carrier provides controlled release of the active compound.
A surgical instrument comprising an elongated shaft and an actuator.
The surgical instrument of claim 1, wherein the actuator controls an end effector.
The surgical instrument of claim 2, wherein the end effector includes opposing jaws.
The surgical instrument of claim 3, wherein the opposing jaws apply a controlled compression force.
